# `atan2`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
atan2(exprY, exprX)
```

Returns the angle in radians between the positive x-axis of a plane
and the point given by the coordinates (`exprX`, `exprY`), as if computed by
`java.lang.Math.atan2`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT atan2(0, 0);
```

Result:

```text
0.0
```
